content_zh:
看着怀里脸蛋红扑扑的勾人小女人，夜爵第一次恨为毛把CK酒店的总统套房设立在第99层，该死的，怎么那么慢啊……他下次一定要跟大哥商量一下，这简直影响他办事儿嘛……o(╯□╰)o！
看着夜爵急躁的样子，可然心里十分满足，有一种诱惑力被人证实的感觉。
可然趁夜爵出神之际，双臂揽上他的脖颈，学着电视剧里的场景，热情地吻上他的唇，咯咯咯的笑了起来！
“嘶——”她的热情令夜爵引以为傲的自制力瞬间崩溃！
这女人，简直是妖精的化身，媚眼如丝，妩媚勾人。
作为夜皇国际集团的总裁，夜爵的身边从来不缺女人，可从来没有一个人，让他如此疯狂的想要她！
夜爵一个倒抽气，再也忍不住，放下可然，将她抵在电梯的角落里，开始狂吻起来。
“唔……”他的吻太过霸道强势，可然忍不住嘤咛出声，这仿佛像是一种鼓励，让夜爵更加兴奋。
“唔……别，我不……”发现他的意图，可然顿时阻止，她才不要在电梯里呢！
正想着，99层到了，夜爵放开可然的唇，一手搂住她，一手继续，朝他的专属总统套房走去。
夜爵一把将可然扔在床上，立即扯掉自己身上的束缚，便猛地扑了上去，将她压在自己身下。
从来没有一个女人，能让他全身如此火热。
他的吻顺着她的额头、眼睛、耳垂......流连忘返……
可然在他的火热攻势下渐渐沦陷，忘情的回应……
夜爵眼里冒着欲火，勾唇轻笑，“小东西，你可真诱人呢……”
夜爵说罢，不再忍耐，与可然来了个亲密接触……
一夜蚀骨缠绵。
第二天早上。
明媚的阳光透过CK酒店总统套房的薄纱窗帘，若隐若现的射进屋子里，正一丝不挂酣睡的两人身上。
突然，蜷缩在男人怀里的女人眼皮跳了跳，缓缓睁开了眼睛。

可然醒来的时候已经是早上十点了。
酒精宿醉的感觉让她的头昏昏沉沉的，可再怎么头昏也比不上身上的酸痛、下身撕裂般的疼痛。
可然下意识的抬头看了一眼将自己拥入怀中的男人，他的侧脸俊美无双，容颜魅惑如妖，真的好帅、好像妖精。
可是，这又是怎么一回事？
可然敲了敲脑袋，猛然想起来，昨天她临时有事从学校回家里，却撞见同父异母的妹妹唐子萱与一周后即将大婚的未婚夫陆旭正在缠绵。
可然怒不可揭，捉奸在床，大骂了这对狗男女后，前往夜店寻欢，喝的烂醉，好像点了夜店的头牌……对！就是她身边的这个男人！
思绪理清，可然想到昨天晚上自己大胆的举动，火辣的回应，脸蹭得就红了起来……
可然囧了……想起昨夜不知道和他有过多少次，这个男人好像不知疲倦般，她被他弄晕过来，又醒来，又晕过去，来回反复了一晚上……
好不容易将弄开那个男人，可然刚下床，便双腿发软的摔倒在地，身体虚脱不已！
“禽兽！”回头看了眼床上的男人，可然怒骂道。
好不容易起身穿上衣服，她却发现找不到自己的手提包了，昨晚醉的太厉害，她根本不记得丢在哪里了……那怎么给他钱？
这是传说中的嫖了没钱给么？
可然囧，撕下床头的便签纸，写了几个字后，便偷偷摸摸的出了房间，转身，扬长而去。
而这边，总裁套房的门刚一关上，夜爵便坐了起来。其实早在可然挣脱他的怀抱时，他便醒了。
唐氏集团的大小姐——唐可然？！
滋味还真不错！
夜爵有些心动，这个女人的味道实在是太好了，昨晚简直让他把持不住沉沦不已，竟然一晚上要了她那么多次还不知餍足。
夜爵将手放到唇边，笑得一脸妖孽，突然瞥到床头柜上的便签纸，顿时一种不好的预感油然而生，拿过一看，只见白色的便签纸上，写着两排清秀的篆体字：
不好意思，我的包包丢了，我不是故意嫖了不给钱的，这是我的手机号，你把卡号发给我，我会把钱打你卡上的，实在很抱歉。
便签纸下方写着她的手机号，还画了一只楚楚可怜的萌兔子！

“嫖了不给钱？”夜爵愣了半响，才消化掉她纸上的意思。

content_en:
Looking at the seductive little woman with flushed cheeks in his arms, Ye Jue hated Mao for the first time for setting up the presidential suite of CK Hotel on the 99th floor. Damn it, why is it so slow... He must discuss it with his elder brother next time. This is really affecting his work... o(╯□╰)o!
Seeing Ye Jue's impatient look, Keran felt very satisfied and felt that her allure had been confirmed.
Keran took advantage of Ye Jue's trance, put his arms around his neck, imitated the scene in the TV series, kissed his lips passionately, and started to giggle!
"Hiss—" Her enthusiasm caused Ye Jue's proud self-control to collapse instantly!
This woman is simply the incarnation of a fairy, with eyes as charming as silk and alluring charm.
As the president of Yehuang International Group, Ye Jue has never lacked women around him, but there has never been one person who made him want her so crazily!
Ye Jue gasped and couldn't bear it anymore. He put down Keran, pushed her into the corner of the elevator, and started kissing her wildly.
"Well..." His kiss was too overbearing and forceful, but he couldn't help but squeak out. This seemed like an encouragement, making Ye Jue even more excited.
"Uh... don't, I don't..." After discovering his intention, Keran immediately stopped him. She didn't want to be in the elevator!
Just as he was thinking about it, the 99th floor arrived. Ye Jue let go of Keran's lips, hugged her with one hand, and continued walking towards his exclusive presidential suite.
Ye Jue threw Keran on the bed, immediately tore off the restraints on her body, and pounced on her, pressing her under him.
There has never been a woman who could make his whole body so hot.
His kisses followed her forehead, eyes, earlobes... lingering...
However, he gradually fell under his fiery offensive and responded with a heartless response...
Ye Jue's eyes were filled with lust, and he chuckled softly, "Little one, you are so tempting..."
After Ye Jue said that, he could no longer bear it and had a close contact with Keran...
A night of bone-crushing lingering.
The next morning.
The bright sunshine filtered through the gauze curtains of the CK Hotel's presidential suite and shone faintly into the room, revealing the naked two people sleeping soundly.
Suddenly, the eyelids of the woman curled up in the man's arms twitched and she slowly opened her eyes.
But it was already ten o'clock in the morning when I woke up.
The feeling of alcohol hangover made her dizzy, but no matter how dizzy she was, it was nothing compared to the soreness in her body and the tearing pain in her lower body.
Keran subconsciously raised his head and glanced at the man who held him in his arms. His side face was unparalleledly handsome, and his face was as charming as a demon. He was really handsome, like a demon.
But what is going on?
Keran knocked her head and suddenly remembered that yesterday she came home from school because of something unexpected, and she ran into her half-sister Tang Zixuan and her fiancé Lu Xu, who was about to get married in a week, having an affair.
Keran was so angry that he caught her in bed. After scolding the couple, she went to the nightclub to have fun. She got very drunk and seemed to have ordered the top card of the nightclub... Yes! It's the man next to her!
After sorting out my thoughts, I suddenly thought about my bold move and hot response last night, and my face turned red...
But she was embarrassed... She thought of how many times she had been with him last night. This man seemed to be tireless. She fainted from him, woke up, fainted again, and went back and forth all night long...
It was hard to get the man away, but as soon as he got out of bed, his legs became weak and he fell to the ground, his body exhausted!
"Beast!" Keran cursed angrily as he looked back at the man on the bed.
After finally getting up and putting on her clothes, she found that she couldn't find her handbag. She was so drunk last night that she couldn't remember where she threw it... So how could she give him money?
Is this the legendary prostitute who has no money?
Ke Ran embarrassed, tore off the note paper on the bedside, wrote a few words, then sneaked out of the room, turned around, and walked away.
And here, the presidential suiteAs soon as the door closed, Ye Jue sat up. In fact, he woke up long before Keran broke away from his arms.
The eldest lady of the Tang Group—Tang Keran? !
It tastes really good!
Ye Jue was a little moved. The taste of this woman was so good. Last night, he couldn't control himself and fell in love with her. He even wanted her so many times in one night and still didn't know he was satisfied.
Ye Jue put his hand to his lips, smiling like a monster. He suddenly glanced at the note paper on the bedside table, and a bad premonition suddenly arose. He took it and took a look, only to see two rows of elegant seal characters written on the white note paper:
Sorry, I lost my bag. I didn’t mean to pay for whoring. This is my mobile phone number. Send me your card number and I will put the money on your card. I’m really sorry.
Underneath the note was written her mobile phone number, and a cute and pitiful rabbit was also drawn!
"Aren't you going to pay me for whoring?" Ye Jue was stunned for a while before digesting what she meant on the paper.
